title: Response Factor Correction for Quantitative Determination of Homooligomeric Protein Binding to DNA by Native Protein Mass Spectrometry
authors: Anthony Blue; Miguel Rodriguez-Escalante; Raul Villacob; Madeline Bannon; George Carpenter; Elyssia Gallagher; Michael Trakselis
one_liner_zh: 该文利用天然蛋白质谱定量同源寡聚蛋白与DNA的结合亲和力，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作，但方法为质谱而非AI或物理模拟，且非TF-DNA体系，相关性有限。
abstract: Over the past two decades, native protein mass spectrometry (nMS) has emerged as a complementary approach for elucidating molecular parameters of biological complexes including stoichiometry and thermodynamic binding. Being able to simultaneously quantify distinct components within heterogeneous mixtures, while also requiring small amounts of material and minimal sample preparation provide numerous advantages over traditional solution-phase biochemical techniques. However, several caveats related to species specific MS signal responses, including changes in response factors (RFs) upon biological complex formation, have not been fully resolved, which has prevented the technique from being widely adopted. Herein, we utilize nMS to determine the stepwise binding affinities of a recombinant single-strand DNA binding protein (SSB) from Saccharolobus solfataricus (Sso) along single-stranded DNA (ssDNA). This work resolves conflicting previous biochemical reports on the stoichiometry and affinities of SsoSSB, while also highlighting the advantages and limitations of nMS quantification. Covalent concatemers of SsoSSB were used to compare RFs of each oligomer as a function of molecular weight and to correct for physical and instrumental parameters that systematically underrepresent abundances of larger mass species. Furthermore, we show that regardless of quantification metric (peak area or intensity) utilized for the nMS data, meaningful biochemical data can be extracted from multicomponent biochemical systems. Importantly, binding affinities determined by nMS are in close agreement with measured bulk solution-phase measurements but have the added benefit of separately quantifying individual binding steps within a multistep assembly process to determine thermodynamic properties of cooperativity.
abstract_zh: 过去二十年间，天然蛋白质质谱（nMS）已成为一种补充方法，用于阐明生物复合物的分子参数，包括化学计量和热力学结合。能够同时定量异质混合物中的不同组分，同时所需材料量少且样品制备简单，这为传统溶液相生化技术提供了诸多优势。然而，与物种特异性质谱信号响应相关的若干注意事项，包括生物复合物形成时响应因子（RFs）的变化，尚未完全解决，这阻碍了该技术的广泛采用。在此，我们利用nMS测定来自硫磺矿硫化叶菌（Saccharolobus solfataricus, Sso）的重组单链DNA结合蛋白（SSB）沿单链DNA（ssDNA）的逐步结合亲和力。这项工作解决了先前关于SsoSSB化学计量和亲和力的相互矛盾的生化报道，同时强调了nMS定量的优势与局限性。使用SsoSSB的共价串联体来比较各寡聚体响应因子随分子量的变化，并校正物理和仪器参数，这些参数系统性地低估了较大质量物种的丰度。此外，我们表明，无论使用何种定量指标（峰面积或强度）处理nMS数据，都能从多组分生化系统中提取有意义的生化数据。重要的是，由nMS确定的结合亲和力与测量的整体溶液相测量结果高度一致，但额外优势在于能分别定量多步组装过程中的各个结合步骤，以确定协同性的热力学性质。
